cards.definition: happening or coming after something else
cards.example: The first implementation failed, but subsequent attempts were successful.
cards.exampleTranslation: Implementasi pertama gagal, tetapi upaya-upaya berikutnya berhasil.

cards.definition: using something to maximum advantage
cards.example: The startup is leveraging AI technology to automate customer service.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan rintisan itu memanfaatkan teknologi AI untuk mengotomatisasi layanan pelanggan.

cards.definition: never having happened or existed before
cards.example: The company experienced unprecedented growth during the digital boom.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan mengalami pertumbuhan yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya selama ledakan digital.

cards.definition: having more than one possible meaning; unclear
cards.example: The feedback from the client was too ambiguous to act upon.
cards.exampleTranslation: Umpan balik dari klien terlalu ambigu untuk ditindaklanjuti.

cards.definition: moving from one thing to another smoothly without any interruptions or problems
cards.example: The migration process was seamless and did not disrupt the users.
cards.exampleTranslation: Proses migrasi berjalan mulus dan tidak mengganggu pengguna.

cards.definition: the possibility that can be made, done, or achieved, or is reasonable
cards.example: We need to conduct a feasibility study before launching the project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami perlu melakukan studi kelayakan sebelum meluncurkan proyek tersebut.

cards.definition: the state of being no longer useful or needed, or a backup system in IT
cards.example: The data center has multiple power sources for redundancy.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pusat data tersebut memiliki beberapa sumber daya untuk sistem cadangan.

cards.definition: to make something less severe, harmful, or painful
cards.example: The new security update is designed to mitigate cyber risks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pembaruan keamanan baru dirancang untuk memitigasi risiko siber.

cards.definition: to examine something very carefully and in great detail
cards.example: Investors will scrutinize the company's financial records.
cards.exampleTranslation: Investor akan memeriksa catatan keuangan perusahaan dengan sangat teliti.

cards.definition: not growing, developing, or making progress
cards.translation: stagnan, jalan di tempat, tidak berkembang
cards.example: Our sales have remained stagnant for three consecutive quarters.
cards.exampleTranslation: Penjualan kami tetap stagnan selama tiga kuartal berturut-turut.

cards.definition: to make an action or a process easier
cards.example: The new software is expected to facilitate better communication among teams.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perangkat lunak baru diharapkan dapat mempermudah komunikasi yang lebih baik antar tim.

cards.definition: a difference between two things that should be the same
cards.example: The accounting team found a discrepancy in the monthly financial report.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim akuntansi menemukan ketidaksesuaian dalam laporan keuangan bulanan.

cards.definition: including all or everything that is necessary
cards.example: The onboarding program provides a comprehensive guide for new hires.
cards.exampleTranslation: Program adaptasi tersebut memberikan panduan menyeluruh bagi karyawan baru.

cards.definition: independent and having the power to make its own decisions or operate alone
cards.example: Tech companies are heavily investing in autonomous vehicles.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan teknologi berinvestasi besar-besaran pada kendaraan otonom.

cards.definition: growing or increasing at a very rapid and accelerating rate
cards.example: The mobile app experienced exponential user growth within a month.
cards.exampleTranslation: Aplikasi seluler tersebut mengalami pertumbuhan pengguna yang eksponensial dalam sebulan.

cards.definition: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
cards.example: She made an eloquent speech that convinced the board members.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia menyampaikan pidato yang persuasif yang meyakinkan para anggota dewan.

cards.definition: to become progressively worse
cards.example: If we do not maintain the system, its performance will deteriorate.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jika kita tidak merawat sistem tersebut, kinerjanya akan memburuk.

cards.definition: to continue to obey a particular rule, law, agreement, or belief
cards.example: All developers must adhere to the company's coding standards.
cards.exampleTranslation: Semua pengembang harus mematuhi standar pengodean perusahaan.

cards.definition: not clearly expressed, known, described, or decided
cards.example: The contract was so vague that it led to a legal dispute.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kontrak tersebut sangat tidak jelas sehingga memicu perselisihan hukum.

cards.definition: an unintentional mistake, or the responsibility for managing something
cards.example: Leaving the database password exposed was a serious oversight.
cards.exampleTranslation: Membiarkan kata sandi basis data terekspos adalah kelalaian yang serius.

cards.definition: not longer produced or used; out of date
cards.example: Cloud computing has made traditional physical servers obsolete for many startups.
cards.exampleTranslation: Komputasi awan telah membuat server fisik tradisional usang bagi banyak perusahaan rintisan.

cards.definition: to start using a plan, system, or tool officially
cards.example: We plan to implement a multi-factor authentication system next week.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami berencana menerapkan sistem autentikasi multifaktor minggu depan.

cards.definition: to officially give resources, money, or time to someone or for a purpose
cards.example: The manager decided to allocate more servers to handle the high traffic.
cards.exampleTranslation: Manajer memutuskan untuk mengalokasikan lebih banyak server untuk menangani lalu lintas yang tinggi.

cards.definition: causing radical change in an industry or market through innovation
cards.example: Uber was a highly disruptive business model in the transportation sector.
cards.exampleTranslation: Uber adalah model bisnis yang sangat disruptif di sektor transportasi.

cards.definition: existing commonly or happening frequently in a particular place or time
cards.example: Phishing scams have become increasingly prevalent in recent years.
cards.exampleTranslation: Penipuan phishing telah menjadi semakin marak dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

cards.definition: something that must exist or happen before something else can happen
cards.example: Basic knowledge of Python is a prerequisite for taking this data science course.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pengetahuan dasar tentang Python adalah prasyarat untuk mengambil kursus sains data ini.

cards.definition: a standard or point of reference against which things may be compared
cards.example: This performance testing tool is used to benchmark database speed.
cards.exampleTranslation: Alat pengujian kinerja ini digunakan untuk mengukur tolok ukur kecepatan basis data.

cards.definition: to put something such as a plan or system in danger of being damaged or destroyed
cards.example: A data breach could seriously jeopardize our company's reputation.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kebocoran data dapat membahayakan reputasi perusahaan kami secara serius.

cards.definition: producing a large amount of money or profit
cards.example: He left his engineering job after signing a lucrative software contract.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia meninggalkan pekerjaan tekniknya setelah menandatangani kontrak perangkat lunak yang sangat menguntungkan.

cards.definition: likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially for the worse
cards.example: Cryptocurrency prices are highly volatile compared to traditional stocks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Harga mata uang kripto sangat tidak stabil dibandingkan dengan saham tradisional.

cards.definition: the careful and detailed examination of something
cards.example: The company's tax reports are under close scrutiny by the government.
cards.exampleTranslation: Laporan pajak perusahaan tersebut sedang berada di bawah pemeriksaan ketat oleh pemerintah.

cards.definition: an event that may happen in the future, especially one that could cause problems
cards.example: Our IT department has a contingency plan in case of a ransomware attack.
cards.exampleTranslation: Departemen IT kami memiliki rencana darurat jika terjadi serangan ransomware.

cards.definition: easy to be physically, emotionally, or digitally attacked or harmed
cards.example: Outdated operating systems are highly vulnerable to cyber threats.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sistem operasi yang usang sangat rentan terhadap ancaman siber.

cards.definition: more important than anything else; supreme
cards.example: When building an e-commerce platform, user data privacy is of paramount importance.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saat membangun platform e-commerce, privasi data pengguna adalah hal yang paling penting.

cards.definition: to notice, understand, or interpret something in a particular way
cards.translation: memandang, melihat, memahami (dari sudut pandang tertentu)
cards.example: Many users perceive the old interface as outdated and slow.
cards.exampleTranslation: Banyak pengguna memandang antarmuka lama sebagai hal yang usang dan lambat.

cards.definition: to do something that is different from what is usual or expected
cards.example: The development team should not deviate from the initial project scope.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim pengembang tidak boleh menyimpang dari ruang lingkup awal proyek.

cards.definition: to improve the efficiency of a process by simplifying its parts
cards.example: The automated deployment pipeline helped streamline our development workflow.
cards.exampleTranslation: Alur penerapan otomatis membantu menyederhanakan alur kerja pengembangan kami.

cards.definition: a connection or relationship between two or more facts or variables
cards.example: Data analysis showed a strong correlation between app performance and user retention.
cards.exampleTranslation: Analisis data menunjukkan korelasi kuat antara kinerja aplikasi dan retensi pengguna.

cards.definition: to find a way in which two opposing ideas or situations can both be true
cards.example: It is difficult to reconcile the team's creative desires with the tight budget constraints.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sulit untuk menyelaraskan keinginan kreatif tim dengan batasan anggaran yang ketat.

cards.definition: based on testing, experience, or observation rather than ideas or theories
cards.example: The researchers provided empirical evidence to support their claims about the new technology.
cards.exampleTranslation: Para peneliti memberikan bukti empiris untuk mendukung klaim mereka tentang teknologi baru tersebut.

cards.definition: a generally accepted opinion or decision among a group of people
cards.example: The board finally reached a consensus regarding the new software vendor.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dewan akhirnya mencapai kesepakatan bersama mengenai pemasok perangkat lunak baru.

cards.definition: capable of working successfully; feasible
cards.example: The startup is still looking for a viable business model to make a profit.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan rintisan itu masih mencari model bisnis yang layak jalan untuk menghasilkan keuntungan.

cards.definition: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
cards.example: Code reviews require meticulous planning and execution to avoid future bugs.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tinjauan kode memerlukan perencanaan dan eksekusi yang sangat teliti untuk menghindari bug di masa mendatang.

cards.definition: to happen, go, or come before something or someone else
cards.example: A series of thorough automated tests must precede the product launch.
cards.exampleTranslation: Serangkaian pengujian otomatis yang menyeluruh harus mendahului peluncuran produk.

cards.definition: a person or thing that has the same position or function as another in a different place
cards.example: The lead engineer in Jakarta met with his overseas counterpart to discuss the server architecture.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ketua teknisi di Jakarta bertemu dengan rekan setaranya di luar negeri untuk membahas arsitektur server.

cards.definition: an assessment of the practicality of a proposed plan or project
cards.example: Our team conducted a feasibility study before deciding to migrate the infrastructure to AWS.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim kami melakukan studi kelayakan sebelum memutuskan untuk memigrasikan infrastruktur ke AWS.

cards.definition: a difficult or unpleasant situation; hardship
cards.example: The company showed resilience and managed to thrive despite economic adversity.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan menunjukkan ketangguhan dan berhasil berkembang meskipun ada tantangan ekonomi.

cards.definition: an established natural tendency to behave in a particular way
cards.example: The new system tracks the user's propensity to click on certain ads.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sistem baru tersebut melacak kecenderungan pengguna untuk mengklik iklan tertentu.

cards.definition: to publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy
cards.example: Our manager is a strong advocate for working from home to maintain life balance.
cards.exampleTranslation: Manajer kami adalah pendukung kuat untuk bekerja dari rumah demi menjaga keseimbangan hidup.

cards.definition: the state of having more than one possible meaning or being unclear
cards.example: To avoid any ambiguity, the documentation should explain every API endpoint clearly.
cards.exampleTranslation: Untuk menghindari keambiguan, dokumentasi harus menjelaskan setiap titik akhir API dengan jelas.

cards.definition: an event or person that causes important change to happen quickly
cards.example: The pandemic acted as a catalyst for digital transformation across industries.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pandemi bertindak as a katalisator untuk transformasi digital di berbagai industri.

cards.definition: logical and consistent; easy to understand because parts fit together well
cards.example: The architect presented a coherent strategy for migrating the legacy database.
cards.exampleTranslation: Arsitek tersebut mempresentasikan strategi yang koheren untuk memigrasikan basis data warisan.

cards.definition: to spread or give out something, especially information, widely
cards.example: The HR department will disseminate the new remote work policy tomorrow.
cards.exampleTranslation: Departemen HR akan menyebarluaskan kebijakan kerja jarak jauh yang baru besok.

cards.definition: extremely severe, strict, or binding
cards.example: The banking application must pass stringent security testing before release.
cards.exampleTranslation: Aplikasi perbankan tersebut harus lolos pengujian keamanan yang ketat sebelum dirilis.

cards.definition: present, appearing, or found everywhere
cards.translation: ada di mana-mana, sangat umum ditemui
cards.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ponsel pintar telah menjadi hal yang ada di mana-mana dalam masyarakat modern.

cards.definition: a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions
cards.translation: pergeseran paradigma, perubahan cara pandang mendasar
cards.example: The rise of cloud computing created a massive paradigm shift in IT infrastructure.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kebangkitan komputasi awan menciptakan pergeseran paradigma besar dalam infrastruktur IT.

cards.definition: something that encourages or motivates a person to do something
cards.example: The company offers financial incentives for employees who earn technical certifications.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan menawarkan insentif finansial bagi karyawan yang mendapatkan sertifikasi teknis.

cards.definition: connected with thinking, knowing, remembering, and judging
cards.example: AI models are being trained to perform complex cognitive tasks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Model AI sedang dilatih untuk melakukan tugas-tugas kognitif yang kompleks.

cards.definition: the act of obeying an order, rule, or request
cards.example: Our software ensures compliance with global data protection regulations.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perangkat lunak kami memastikan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi perlindungan data global.

cards.definition: stopping and starting over a period, not continuous
cards.translation: tersendat-sendat, kadang ada kadang tidak, bersela
cards.example: The server monitoring tool detected intermittent network failures.
cards.exampleTranslation: Alat pemantau server mendeteksi kegagalan jaringan yang tersendat-sendat.

cards.definition: being an extremely important and basic characteristic of a person or thing
cards.example: Flexibility is an intrinsic value of agile project management.
cards.exampleTranslation: Fleksibilitas adalah nilai intrinsik dari manajemen proyek yang lincah (agile).

cards.definition: examined very carefully in order to find details or mistakes
cards.translation: diperiksa dengan teliti, dicermati secara mendalam
cards.example: Every line of code was scrutinized during the security audit.
cards.exampleTranslation: Setiap baris kode diperiksa dengan teliti selama audit keamanan.

cards.definition: to use something you already have in order to achieve something new or better
cards.example: We should leverage our existing user base to promote the new app feature.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kita harus memanfaatkan basis pengguna yang ada untuk mempromosikan fitur aplikasi baru.

cards.definition: to agree with someone or have the same opinion
cards.example: The team leads concur that the deployment should be postponed.
cards.exampleTranslation: Para ketua tim sependapat bahwa penerapan harus ditunda.

cards.definition: causing harm or damage
cards.example: Working without proper rest can be detrimental to code quality.
cards.exampleTranslation: Bekerja tanpa istirahat yang cukup dapat berdampak buruk pada kualitas kode.

cards.definition: spoken or written discussion of a particular subject
cards.example: The online discourse about AI ethics is growing rapidly.
cards.exampleTranslation: Wacana daring tentang etika AI berkembang dengan cepat.

cards.definition: different in every way; made up of completely different elements
cards.translation: berbeda sama sekali, heterogen, tak sejenis
cards.example: The engineer managed to integrate data from disparate software systems.
cards.exampleTranslation: Teknisi tersebut berhasil mengintegrasikan data dari sistem perangkat lunak yang berbeda sama sekali.

cards.definition: to change something so that it is false or looks strange
cards.example: Low-quality camera sensors tend to distort the image colors.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sensor kamera berkualitas rendah cenderung mendistorsi warna gambar.

cards.definition: information received by means of observation or experimentation
cards.translation: data empiris, data lapangan hasil nyata
cards.example: We need empirical data from actual users, not just internal feedback.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami membutuhkan data empiris dari pengguna nyata, bukan hanya umpan balik internal.

cards.definition: an effort or attempt to do something, especially something new or difficult
cards.example: Building a new operating system is a massive technological endeavour.
cards.exampleTranslation: Meningkatkan sistem operasi baru adalah upaya teknologi yang sangat besar.

cards.definition: to consider one thing to be the same or as important as another
cards.example: You cannot always equate working long hours with high productivity.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu tidak selalu bisa menyamakan jam kerja yang panjang dengan produktivitas yang tinggi.

cards.definition: wrong or incorrect; based on mistaken facts
cards.example: The algorithm generated erroneous results due to a missing parameter.
cards.exampleTranslation: Algoritma tersebut menghasilkan hasil yang keliru karena parameter yang hilang.

cards.definition: clear and exact, leaving no doubt about the meaning
cards.translation: eksplisit, tegas dan jelas tanpa sensor/rahasia
cards.example: The client gave explicit instructions not to change the database schema.
cards.exampleTranslation: Klien memberikan instruksi eksplisit untuk tidak mengubah skema basis data.

cards.definition: to change continuously, especially by going up and down
cards.example: Server response times may fluctuate depending on network traffic.
cards.exampleTranslation: Waktu respons server dapat berfluktuasi tergantung pada lalu lintas jaringan.

cards.definition: to encourage the development or growth of ideas or feelings
cards.example: Open-source projects help foster collaboration among developers worldwide.
cards.exampleTranslation: Proyek sumber terbuka membantu menumbuhkan kolaborasi di antara para pengembang di seluruh dunia.

cards.definition: a supporting structure around which something can be built
cards.example: React is a popular JavaScript framework used for building user interfaces.
cards.exampleTranslation: React adalah kerangka kerja JavaScript populer yang digunakan untuk membangun antarmuka pengguna.

cards.definition: a system in which members of an organization are ranked according to status
cards.example: Our startup prefers a flat structure rather than a traditional corporate hierarchy.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan rintisan kami lebih menyukai struktur yang rata daripada hierarki perusahaan tradisional.

cards.definition: an idea or explanation that is based on a few facts but not yet proven
cards.example: We conducted an A/B test to validate our hypothesis about user behavior.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami melakukan uji A/B untuk memvalidasi hipotesis kami tentang perilaku pengguna.

cards.definition: suggested or understood without being stated directly
cards.example: By clicking accept, you implicitly agree to the updated terms of service.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dengan mengklik setuju, kamu secara implisit menyetujui ketentuan layanan yang diperbarui.

cards.definition: to officially force a rule, tax, or punishment to be obeyed
cards.example: The manager decided to impose stricter guidelines on pull requests.
cards.exampleTranslation: Manajer memutuskan untuk memberlakukan pedoman yang lebih ketat pada pull request.

cards.definition: naturally existing in a place rather than arriving from another place; native
cards.example: The tech program aims to support indigenous entrepreneurs in remote areas.
cards.exampleTranslation: Program teknologi tersebut bertujuan untuk mendukung wirausahawan asli di daerah terpencil.

cards.definition: the basic systems and structures that a country or organization needs to work properly
cards.example: AWS allows businesses to scale their IT infrastructure rapidly.
cards.exampleTranslation: AWS memungkinkan bisnis untuk meningkatkan infrastruktur IT mereka dengan cepat.

cards.definition: existing as a natural or permanent feature or quality of something
cards.example: There are inherent security risks when using third-party APIs.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ada risiko keamanan yang melekat saat menggunakan API pihak ketiga.

cards.definition: to slow down or prevent a process or growth
cards.example: Poor network bandwidth will inhibit the database replication process.
cards.exampleTranslation: Lebar pita (bandwidth) jaringan yang buruk akan menghambat proses replikasi basis data.

cards.definition: using new methods or ideas; advanced and original
cards.example: They won the award for their innovative approach to energy efficiency.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mereka memenangkan penghargaan atas pendekatan inovatif mereka terhadap efisiensi energi.

cards.definition: to combine two or more things to make them work together
cards.example: We need to integrate the new payment gateway into our mobile app.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami perlu mengintegrasikan gerbang pembayaran baru ke dalam aplikasi seluler kami.

cards.definition: to intentionally become involved in a difficult situation to improve it
cards.example: The tech lead had to intervene when the server deployment completely stalled.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ketua teknisi harus turun tangan ketika penerapan server benar-benar macet.

cards.definition: to show or prove that something is right, reasonable, or necessary
cards.example: The cost of the new server hardware is hard to justify given our low traffic.
cards.exampleTranslation: Biaya perangkat keras server baru sulit dibenarkan mengingat lalu lintas kita yang rendah.

cards.definition: small and not important; minor
cards.example: The code optimization resulted in only a marginal improvement in speed.
cards.exampleTranslation: Optimalisasi kode hanya menghasilkan peningkatan kecepatan yang marjinal.

cards.definition: to change something slightly, especially to improve it
cards.example: You need to modify the configurations file to enable the backup feature.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu perlu memodifikasi berkas konfigurasi untuk mengaktifkan fitur cadangan.

cards.definition: despite the fact or thing mentioned
cards.example: Notwithstanding the tight deadline, the team delivered a bug-free system.
cards.exampleTranslation: Meskipun tenggat waktu ketat, tim berhasil mengirimkan sistem yang bebas dari bug.

cards.definition: something you plan to achieve (n) or based on real facts, not feelings (adj)
cards.example: Our primary objective is to reduce application downtime by 90%.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tujuan utama kami adalah mengurangi waktu henti aplikasi sebesar 90%.

cards.definition: training or information given to prepare for a new situation or job
cards.example: New developers undergo a week of technical orientation on our tech stack.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pengembang baru menjalani satu minggu orientasi teknis tentang ekosistem teknologi kami.

cards.definition: a particular way of considering or looking at something; viewpoint
cards.example: Working closely with customer support gave developers a new perspective on product bugs.
cards.exampleTranslation: Bekerja erat dengan dukungan pelanggan memberikan pengembang perspektif baru tentang bug produk.

cards.definition: exactly and accurately
cards.example: The cron job triggers precisely at midnight every day.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tugas cron (otomatisasi) terpicu secara tepat pada tengah malam setiap hari.

cards.definition: relating to how good something is, rather than its quantity
cards.example: We gathered qualitative feedback through user interviews.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami mengumpulkan umpan balik kualitatif melalui wawancara pengguna.

cards.definition: to make something stronger, especially an idea, a system, or a structure
cards.example: The latest security incident serves to reinforce the need for regular updates.
cards.exampleTranslation: Insiden keamanan terbaru berfungsi untuk memperkuat perlunya pembaruan berkala.

cards.definition: the ability of an organization or app to keep its employees or users
cards.example: Improving UI design can significantly boost user retention rate.
cards.exampleTranslation: Meningkatkan desain UI dapat mendongkrak tingkat retensi pengguna secara signifikan.

cards.definition: not loud, bright, noticeable, or obvious in any way
cards.example: There is a subtle bug in the authentication loop that only shows up occasionally.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ada bug samar dalam perulangan autentikasi yang hanya muncul sesekali.

cards.definition: the quality of being logically or legally sound and acceptable
cards.example: The system automatically checks the token validity before granting access.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sistem secara otomatis memeriksa validitas token sebelum memberikan akses.
